'''Lord Glacius' Staff''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Lord Glacius the Eternal]], a [[boss]] in [[Bjora Marches]]. 

== Stats ==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Cold damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Water Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]])
:[[Enchantment]]s last 20% longer
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same skin as the [[Icicle Staff]].

== Replica ==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*[[Tidal Staff]] from collectors [[Nuwisha]] or [[Jwup]] or crafter [[Ruricu]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Enchanting]]
OR
*One of the following [[Water Magic]] [[staves]]:
**[[Tidal Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
**[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Elemental Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Staff]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Staff of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Charr Staff]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Staff]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Staff]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Staff]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Enchanting]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Have Faith]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
[[Unending Night's Grasp]] has stats identical to this item.

== Trivia ==
*Before the [[Game updates/20080529|May 29, 2008]] update, [[Spafrod Iceblood]] would incorrectly drop this staff.
